summary: The RptMnuFixedTermAppointments component is a user control for handling fixed term appointment reports. It provides functionality to set start and end dates for reports, validate input, and export data to Excel.
purpose: To manage and display fixed term appointment reports, allowing date selection and data export.

workflows.name: Page Pre-Render
steps: Check if UserSession is not null.
Perform code lookup for report details.

workflows.name: Export to Excel
steps: Set stored procedure name to ReportFixedTermAppointments.
Execute database query and retrieve data.

business_rules: UserSession must be valid to perform code lookup.
Dates must be entered and validated before exporting.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator for start and end dates
conditions: if UserSession is null, do not perform code lookup.
if reportHTML is not empty, make pnlReportHTML visible.
system_behavior: Registers JavaScript strings for client-side execution.
Handles asynchronous postbacks to update the page without full reload.
Uses SQL to retrieve and process report data.
exceptions: Generated code warnings regarding auto-generated fields that should not be modified manually.
